prompt:
Use your built-in image_gen tool to make exactly 1 separate image from this spec. Follow the spec literally, do not add text, logos or watermarks unless the spec asks. Do not run shell commands or write files. When done, reply with the absolute path of each generated image file, one per line, nothing else.

SPEC:
Top-down orthographic game level plan of an East Asian fantasy town in Yuruma, viewed straight from above like a readable map for level design. Clear street network, plazas, gates and walls, building footprints with curved tiled roofs seen from above, rivers and bridges, trees as round canopies. Strong contrast between walkable streets (light packed earth / stone) and buildings (dark roofs). No perspective tilt, no text, no labels, no compass.
Top-down orthographic level plan of one city block: the Street of Masters in the orc capital Gharn. The image covers exactly 80 m (left-right, west to east) by 40 m (top-bottom, north to south). A straight cobbled street 10 m wide runs left to right through the exact vertical middle of the image. At the left edge the street enters through a small three-bay gate; at the right edge it ends at a timber palisade city wall running top to bottom.
On BOTH sides of the street: continuous rows of attached rectangular townhouses (each 8-10 m wide along the street, 8 m deep), facades touching the street, curved dark-tile roofs seen from above, small gaps only for two side lanes. Behind each row: narrow back yards with workshop clutter (hides on frames, barrels, wood piles, carts), bounded by low fences.
Exactly in the middle of the street (x = 40 m): a crossing with a 3 m side lane going up and down, and a small square 14 m across with a round stone well in its centre, four stone lanterns at its corners and a totem pole.
Along the street at both house fronts: awnings, small stalls, lantern posts every 8 m; strings of lanterns across the street every 16 m drawn as thin dotted lines.
Clean readable map style, no text, no labels.
Aspect: landscape 3:2.
